description: This file defines an interface (abstract class) IEquationOptions within the Graphing namespace, specifying virtual getter, setter, and reset methods for various graphical properties related to equations, such as color, line style, line width, and point radius.

classes.name: IEquationOptions
classes.description: An interface for configuring visual options of graph equations, including color, line style, line width, and point radius, with methods to get, set, and reset these properties.

methods.name: GetGraphColor
methods.description: Retrieves the current color used for the graph.

methods.name: SetGraphColor
methods.description: Sets the color used for the graph.

methods.name: ResetGraphColor
methods.description: Resets the graph color to its default value.

methods.name: GetLineStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the current line style for the graph.

methods.name: SetLineStyle
methods.description: Sets the line style for the graph.

methods.name: ResetLineStyle
methods.description: Resets the line style to its default.

methods.name: GetLineWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the width of the graph lines.

methods.name: SetLineWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the graph lines.

methods.name: ResetLineWidth
methods.description: Resets the line width to its default.

methods.name: GetSelectedEquationLineWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the line width for selected equations.

methods.name: SetSelectedEquationLineWidth
methods.description: Sets the line width for selected equations.

methods.name: ResetSelectedEquationLineWidth
methods.description: Resets the selected equation line width to default.

methods.name: GetPointRadius
methods.description: Retrieves the radius of points in the graph.

methods.name: SetPointRadius
methods.description: Sets the radius of points in the graph.

methods.name: ResetPointRadius
methods.description: Resets the point radius to default.

methods.name: GetSelectedEquationPointRadius
methods.description: Retrieves the point radius for selected equations.

methods.name: SetSelectedEquationPointRadius
methods.description: Sets the point radius for selected equations.

methods.name: ResetSelectedEquationPointRadius
methods.description: Resets the selected equation point radius to default.
